title: Connected components map onto connected components under arbitrary field extension for arbitrary schemes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof cannot rely on finite type or quasi-compactness of the scheme. It isolates the maximal weakly étale subfield of global functions, proves geometric connectedness over that field, and identifies every extended component as a whole fibre over a field quotient of the tensor product.
